hook.name: OmniPriceHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook implementing a cross-chain virtual order book that prices swaps using a threshold-signed global USD reference price converted to local quote via Chainlink oracle. Between swaps, all inventory sits in a visible straddle position; each swap removes the book, JIT-mints a one-tick fill band at the coordinator price, executes, then distributes fees to four recipients and rebuilds the straddle.
